resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Accounting-style inequalities are central in Six Birds Theory, but they do not by themselves rule out catastrophic extremes: highly localized ``needle'' probes can satisfy global budgets while producing large peaks. We ask when packaging plus accounting forces anti-localization, and propose Reflexive SBT: a capacity-based audit of the packaged artifacts (subspaces, feasibility dictionaries, and route ladders). We define a localization metric _j at cell scale 2^ -j , compute it via an eigenvalue method, and upper-bound it using three auditable capacities: subspace trace/diagonal dispersion, sparse feasibility conditioning on small supports, and a route-union ledger charging multi-route inflation. We find three controlled separations: (i) shift-invariant channels (Fourier/circulant) have uniform projector diagonals and _j follows the deterministic m/2^j bound, while diagonal disorder drives _j rapidly toward 1 compared with full-noise perturbations; (ii) feasibility-level needles arise exactly when small-support conditioning collapses ( sigma_ → 0 ) and are absent in random baselines; (iii) for spectral packaging, route mismatch spikes only at degenerate cutoffs and is eliminated by a canonical tie-break, with remaining route effects captured by the union ledger. This turns the anti-localization hinge into a reproducible checklist and yields a conditional theorem: vanishing capacity implies _j→ 0 along a ladder. We are explicit that Reflexive SBT is not proven here to universally drive capacities to zero; we prove the capacity implies anti-localization implications and provide auditable closure evidence on canonical failure and repair modes.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Previous demonstrations of contextuality-type obstruction start from quantum mechanics or from externally specified measurement scenarios. We show that the same locally-Boolean-but-globally-obstructed structure can arise from an autonomous emergence framework—Six Birds Theory—without importing Hilbert space, amplitudes, or the Born rule. The formal vehicle is a finite event package: a family of stable-record contexts, each carrying a finite Boolean event algebra, together with a layer-relative shared-event identification and an audit layer. Obstruction is the failure of admissible global realization for that package. The computational framework combines exact and quotient-backed feasibility, structural and statistical deficits, provenance auditing, and false-positive controls. The evidence base includes a classical control, a boundary-case epistemic calibration, an explicit finite parity/context witness, and autonomous discovery organized by mechanism, lens, and packaging axes. The results are stratified: mechanism variation yields package-sensitive structure with a quotient-backed witness under a weaker claim ceiling; lens variation closes with a cross-resolution strict extension obstruction on fixed support; and packaging variation produces the strongest current obstruction, subject to a package conflict caveat. Where applicable, the principal cases persist under bounded robustness checks. The paper therefore provides the first computationally explicit evidence that contextuality-type obstruction can emerge from a system's own packaging structure rather than from quantum theory or an externally imposed scenario.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Six Birds theory studies finite systems observed through deterministic coarse-grainings (``lenses'') using a small audited vocabulary of primitives. This paper proves eight no-go theorems that constrain when common emergence narratives can be made honest in a finite, checkable setting. For a finite Markov system and horizon T , define an arrow audit as the Kullback–Leibler divergence between the observed path law and its time reversal. We prove a deterministic data-processing inequality: observation cannot increase arrow. As a consequence, any reversible system started in stationarity has zero observed arrow, even when the observation supports nontrivial protocol structure. Further results give graph-theoretic obstructions for force-like antisymmetric drives (exactness on forests and zero cycle sums), a finite variational identity for best macro-kernels and closure deficit, and a bounded-interface saturation theorem that prevents unbounded laddering. Together these theorems delimit what can and cannot be certified as emergent from audited primitives in finite models.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: When must an operator-valued obstruction associated with an involutive system vanish? This paper answers that question inside the Six Birds framework by naming Self-Dual Trace Confinement (SDTC) as the recognition source for formed closures with genuine involutive self-duality. The mechanism is the duality-confinement membrane theorem: for an involutive object ledger with separating anti-invariant readout, a sequence of positive domination records B_n with B_n 0 forces the anti-invariant ledger to vanish and confines visible mass to the fixed locus of the duality. The supporting apparatus develops the involutive object ledger, the anti-invariant ledger and trace identity, direct qualitative and quantitative confinement, completed-domination bridges, Douglas factorization in typed-cone form, exhaustive moving ledgers, and optimized scalar trace budgets. Operator-theoretic realization over trace-class operators is an open extension, as is a derivation of the AM–GM step inside a typed real-arithmetic structure. The development is formalized in Lean as a mathlib-free mechanization at the typed positive-cone level (Appendix ). Cross-substrate generalizations such as CPT symmetry, gauge invariance, quantum self-adjointness, and function-field RH are presented as structural predictions, not theorems; the paper develops the abstract apparatus layer and names the hypotheses any substrate-specific application must supply.
